intent: Add reduced-motion accessibility guardrails and Kanban loading, empty, and retryable error states; document PSI-112 in Obsidian.
summary: Motion accessibility guardrails and Kanban state coverage (PSI-112). CODE: (1) Added shared motion-safe.ts token helper collapsing staggers, fades, tap/hover physics, and transitions to static under prefers-reduced-motion; wired useReducedMotion() into animated-number, live-pulse (infinite halo now static), animated-stats-grid, animated-charts-grid, task-card, daily-digest-card, tour-modal (progress bar and step dots now transform-only scaleX instead of width), and ai-chat-interface. (2) Replaced Kanban height-based accordion with grid-template-rows collapse (transform/opacity only). (3) Added KanbanBoardSkeleton (shape-matching loader), KanbanBoardEmptyState / KanbanColumnEmptyState (composed empty states), and KanbanBoardErrorState with retry in kanban-board/board-column. (4) Unit tests: motion-safe.test.ts (reduced-motion branches) and kanban-state.test.ts. 130 frontend tests and 22 edge function tests pass; typecheck and oxlint clean.

changes.note: Shared reduced-motion token helpers (staggerContainer, fadeRiseItem, tapPhysics, motionTransition)
infinite halo animation disabled under reduced motion; solid dot retained
stagger + hover collapse under reduced motion
height accordion replaced with grid-template-rows (transform/opacity only); reduced-motion gated
progress bar and step dots use scaleX (transform-only); step/callout transitions reduced-motion gated
composed empty states and error state with retry
wire skeleton, empty-board, and error-with-retry states
unit tests for skeleton, empty, and error states

verification.manual: 130 frontend unit tests pass (574 expect calls), 22 edge function tests pass; tsc --noEmit and oxlint clean. Confirmed reduced-motion branches via motion-safe tests and instantiation of skeleton/empty/error states.

risks: Motion components now depend on useReducedMotion() context; all call sites verified under both motion settings.
